description: Atomically write the session's deterministic Evidence bundle to the requested local path. Existing files require overwrite: true; records and manifests use canonical byte-stable ordering.

inputSchema.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the exported evidence bundle; relative paths are rejected.

title: Export Evidence Bundle
